title: 清冷写真
description:
(Masterpiece, top quality, best quality, 8k, raw photo:1.2),
Subject: A handsome 21-year-old East Asian male, solo, clear skin, slightly wet messy black hair, wearing a crisp white dress shirt with top buttons unbuttoned, exposing collarbone.
Action: Close-up portrait, leaning against a clean wall, looking directly at the camera with a pure but melancholic gaze, catchlight in eyes, hand gently touching the neck.
Style: Chinese magazine editorial (like GQ China), high-key but moody photography, soft film grain, Japanese minimal aesthetic.
Lighting: Soft diffused daylight, overexposed slightly for a dreamy airy feel, soft shadows on face, pure atmosphere.
Background: Clean white or light grey minimalist background, negative space.
Vibe: Youthful, clean, refreshing, "salt" style, emotional.
